definitions.explanation: the main or final stage of a competition, as opposed to preliminary rounds

examples.japanese: {本選|ほんせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
⟦{予選|よせん}→予選：04745_yosen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通過|つうか}して→通過する：22435_tsuukasuru⟧{本選|ほんせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出場|しゅつじょう}する→出場する：20348_shutsujousuru⟧。
examples.english: To pass the preliminaries and compete in the finals.
